Text:
Already on Making Tax Digital? Your next quarterly update is due this Saturday, 7 November.

This one applies to ADIs whose lesson income was over £50,000 and who started MTD for Income Tax in April 2026. It covers 6 April to 5 October (or 1 April to 30 September if you chose calendar quarters).

Two things worth knowing:
- HMRC has said it won't give penalty points for late quarterly updates in this first tax year. That's not a reason to leave it, but don't panic.
- You still send an update if a quarter had little or no income.

Most instructors join from April 2027, when the threshold drops to £30,000. Our guide explains who's in:
https://driveschoolpro.com/blog/making-tax-digital-driving-instructors/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=nov26&utm_content=n04

DriveSchoolPro isn't MTD software, but it keeps your lesson income records tidy. This isn't tax advice; check GOV.UK or your accountant.
